name: ARMOR-RADAR
notes: The core, the node state machine, the sensor decoders (including a real LD2450 frame) and the Wi-Fi board layer are tested on a computer: 859 checks across four host test binaries, all passing. Its emitted payloads and device states are all accepted by ARMOR-COMMON's shared contract checker. Hardware pin assignment and PoE board verification, and running on a real board, are still deliberately pending.
